//arch: `arch` is the static architecture guard: import cycles are an ERROR, orphan modules a WARN.
It cruises two trees (orchestrator+packages from here, ui/ with its own @/* alias config)
and fails on any violation NOT already recorded in the known-violations baselines.
THE BASELINES ARE A RATCHET AND MAY ONLY EVER SHRINK.
freeze the cycles that already existed when the guard landed, so that the rule could be set
to `error` on day one without breaking a tree that is already 28-of-49 folders cyclic.
DO NOT run `arch:baseline` to make a failure go away. If `npm run arch` fails, you added a
cycle: break it. Regenerating to ADD entries is forbidden and defeats the entire mechanism.
The only legitimate regenerations are (a) you fixed cycles and want the stale entries
dropped, or (b) you switched on a brand-new rule and said so in the commit message.
A PR whose diff GROWS a baseline file should not be approved without an explicit reason.
